title: Gracie's
venue_description:
Venue Overview

Gracie's is a downtown Salt Lake City gastropub that has been a cornerstone of the local music and dining scene since 2009. Located in the heart of downtown this bar and restaurant offers unexpectedly great food from what they describe as a decidedly great bar creating a unique dining and entertainment experience.

Music Programming

Gracie's has become one of Salt Lake City's most important music venues featuring live music or DJs almost every night of the week. The venue is particularly known for hosting Gracie's Bluegrass Tuesdays a weekly series presented by Hot House West that showcases local and touring bluegrass and old-time bands. On the second and last Tuesday of each month the Trash Moon Collective House Band performs and hosts an on-stage jam session from 8:30-10:00 PM giving musicians of all levels an opportunity to perform.

Atmosphere and Features

The venue features both indoor and outdoor seating including a popular rooftop patio that offers views of downtown Salt Lake City. Inside guests will find pool tables big screen TVs for sporting events and a full bar with an extensive drink menu. The space has a welcoming gastropub atmosphere that attracts a diverse crowd of music lovers diners and nightlife enthusiasts.

Food and Drink

While known primarily as a bar Gracie's offers a full menu of American pub food including favorites like poutine seafood mac and cheese pork chops and vegetarian options. The restaurant serves brunch on weekends and offers lunch dinner and late-night dining options seven days a week. The venue requires patrons to be 21+ with ID scanning at entry.

Community Impact

Gracie's has earned recognition as one of Salt Lake City's best neighborhood bars and has become particularly important to the local bluegrass and acoustic music scenes. Through partnerships with organizations like Hot House West a 501(c)3 nonprofit dedicated to elevating Salt Lake's acoustic music scene the venue provides crucial performance opportunities for both established and emerging musicians.
location: 326 S West Temple St Salt Lake City UT 84101

title: Pat's BBQ
venue_description:
Venue Overview

Pat's BBQ is an award-winning barbecue restaurant and music venue that has been serving Salt Lake City since 2004. Located on Commonwealth Avenue this establishment has become renowned for both its exceptional smoked meats and its commitment to supporting local musicians through Howie's Hall its dedicated music space.

Awards and Recognition

Pat's has earned significant recognition including being voted both Best BBQ and Best Catering Company in 2023 - a historic achievement as the first business to win both awards simultaneously. The restaurant was featured on Food Network's Diners Drive-ins and Dives where host Guy Fieri praised owner Pat Barber as a culinary professional for his masterful smoking techniques including 10-hour smoked briskets chickens and sausages.

Music Programming

Howie's Hall at Pat's BBQ features live music Thursday through Saturday nights showcasing some of the best local and touring bands in Utah. The venue has become particularly important to the acoustic music community hosting the monthly IAMA Acoustic Showcase which provides a platform for Utah's local singer-songwriters and original artists. The IAMA showcase runs on select Thursdays from 6:30-8:30 PM.

Dining Experience

The restaurant specializes in award-winning ribs pulled pork chicken burnt ends and other southern comfort foods available for both dine-in and take-out. Pat's on Commonwealth is a full-service restaurant offering draft beer high-point canned beer wine liquor and cocktails. The venue also provides free party room usage for gatherings and events.

Atmosphere

Pat's BBQ offers a casual comfortable environment where guests can enjoy quality food while experiencing live performances. The venue has maintained its position as a Salt Lake City gem for nearly two decades combining excellent barbecue with a genuine commitment to supporting local music and creating community gathering spaces. The restaurant is open Monday through Saturday for both lunch and dinner service.
location: 155 W Commonwealth Ave Salt Lake City UT 84115

title: Alchemy Coffee
venue_description:
Venue Overview

Alchemy Coffee is a distinctive independent coffee shop in Salt Lake City that has been serving the community since 2005. Located in a large gray building the shop is known for its unique spooky aesthetic featuring skeletons haunted decor and eclectic artwork year-round creating an atmosphere unlike any other coffee shop in Utah.

Coffee and Food

The shop uses exclusively organic beans from Salt Lake Roasting Company a well-known local roaster ensuring high-quality coffee drinks. Popular menu items include the White Witch (spicy chai with rose white chocolate and cinnamon) the Mayan Mocha (vanilla chocolate and cayenne) and various specialty lattes. Adding the phrase Get it spooky adds an espresso shot to any drink. The shop also offers locally-sourced organic vegan and gluten-free pastries treats and foods as well as made-to-order soups salads and sandwiches.

Music and Arts Programming

Every Tuesday from 6:00-9:00 PM Alchemy hosts an open mic night with a unique rule - no cover songs allowed. This policy creates a space specifically for original songwriters and musicians with rotating hosts from IAMA and the community. Sign-up starts at 5:45 PM and performers must be present. The shop has also hosted after-hours art shows and features rotating local artwork on its walls creating a gallery-like atmosphere.

Community Space

Alchemy Coffee has earned a reputation for having some of the comfiest couches in Salt Lake City along with plenty of tables and chairs both inside and outside. The shop is dog-friendly and provides free WiFi making it an ideal workspace. Drip coffee in a to-stay mug is remarkably affordable at just 93 cents. The venue welcomes all people and has created an inclusive space where customers can be themselves.

Culture and Atmosphere

The owner Jason believes in the magic of coffee preparation viewing baristas as coffee witches and alchemists who craft the golden beverage for the community. This philosophy is reflected in the creative freedom given to staff who are encouraged to express their individuality. The shop's music selection ranges from ambient groovy dance to outlaw country and Celtic. Alchemy has become a true community hub where local artists musicians and coffee lovers gather to connect and create.
location: 390 E 1700 S Salt Lake City UT 84115

title: Clubhouse
venue_description:
Venue Overview

Clubhouse is a historic event venue located in downtown Salt Lake City originally built by the Ladies' Literary Club of Utah in 1913. The building stands as one of the finest examples of Prairie School style architecture in Utah and serves as both a cultural landmark and vibrant community arts space.

Community Programming

Clubhouse is committed to uplifting local Salt Lake communities through creative programming historic preservation and educational opportunities. The venue hosts Stage Presence a weekly community open mic showcase every Tuesday from 7:30-10:00 PM. This event welcomes spoken word music poetry philosophy storytelling improv and comedy with open mic signup beginning when doors open at 7:00 PM. Entry is $15 or 2 for $20 with volunteer opportunities available for those unable to contribute financially.

Performance Guidelines

Stage Presence encourages performers to think outside the box welcoming original music creative covers beat boxing a cappella and acoustic performances. The stage is equipped with a piano guitar and 1-3 microphone inputs. The event is designed for an 18+ audience due to the sensitivity of topics discussed and maintains a strict no hate speech policy with requests for trigger warnings before sensitive content.

Additional Programming

Beyond the weekly open mic Clubhouse hosts a variety of cultural and artistic events including live figure drawing sessions jazz performances like The Jazz Room: A Journey to the Heart of New Orleans darkroom rentals (the only public darkroom in Salt Lake City) and various special events throughout the year. The venue offers Programme Membership for $75/month providing unlimited attendance at all Clubhouse events plus additional benefits.

Private Events

Clubhouse serves as a premiere location for weddings corporate parties wellness events photoshoots musical performances galas fundraisers and celebrations. The historic building's unique architecture and commitment to community arts make it an ideal venue for both public programming and private special events.
location: 850 E South Temple St Salt Lake City UT 84102

title: Sugar House Coffee
venue_description:
Venue Overview

Sugar House Coffee is the beloved independent coffee shop located in the heart of Salt Lake City's vibrant Sugar House neighborhood. The shop has established itself as a true community hub known for exceptional coffee welcoming atmosphere and dedication to supporting local artists and musicians.

Music and Arts

Every Tuesday starting at 7:00 PM Sugar House Coffee hosts an open mic night with sign-up beginning at 6:30 PM. Performers get 5-minute slots to showcase their talents whether music poetry or other creative expressions. The shop features a piano that patrons are welcome to play and the Tuesday night open mics regularly feature talented local performers. The venue has earned recognition for the high quality of talent performing at these weekly events.

Coffee and Food

The shop offers a wide menu of specialty coffee drinks including popular items like the Cuban Revolver Jade's Purple Haze the spicy dirty Chai and the Mayan Mocha. Drinks can be customized and the skilled baristas are known for creating unique concoctions. Food offerings include avocado toast with egg and bacon quiche bread pudding and fresh basil-pesto rolls all emphasizing local and quality ingredients.

Community Events

In addition to the weekly open mic Sugar House Coffee hosts board game nights and bi-monthly Makers Markets providing platforms for local artisans to sell their work. The shop has become a gathering place for the community where friends meet students study and artists create in a supportive inclusive environment.

Atmosphere and Values

Sugar House Coffee is proudly LGBTQ+ friendly and has created a safe welcoming space for all people. The shop features eclectic decor comfortable seating options both inside and out free WiFi and a community-driven atmosphere. Customers describe the space as having incredible ambiance with the perfect balance of energy and coziness. The shop's walls feature a map where customers can mark their favorite Salt Lake City spots books in Spanish and English and a bulletin board of neighborhood news reflecting the shop's deep connection to the local community. Open Monday-Friday 7AM-9PM Saturday 7AM-8PM Sunday 8AM-8PM.
location: 2011 S 1100 E Salt Lake City UT 84106

title: Hog Wallow Pub
venue_description:
Venue Overview

The Hog Wallow Pub is a legendary 21+ establishment with a storied history dating back to 1947. Located at the base of Big Cottonwood Canyon and secluded among pine trees this venue sits kitty-corner to the historic Old Mill ruin representing the latest incarnation of the oldest and most notorious bar in the Cottonwood Heights area.

History

The venue was established when a returning World War II veteran converted an abandoned Civilian Conservation Corps bunkhouse into an out-of-the-way watering hole originally named The Branding Iron. Over the decades the bar has operated under several names including The Wagon Wheel Demete's The Fox and Bottle Inn and D.J.'s Beer Garden before becoming The Hog Wallow Pub in 1997. The venue is named after a rapid on the Green River.

Music Programming

Hog Wallow features live music Wednesday through Saturday with Monday nights dedicated to open jam sessions starting at 9:00 PM. The venue showcases a diverse range of genres including rock jazz blues reggae bluegrass and Americana. Bands and performers can sign up to jam with house musicians creating an inclusive environment for both seasoned professionals and emerging artists.

Atmosphere and Features

Housed in a cozy log cabin the venue features an intricate wood carving of a woman behind the bar that catches the eye of first-time visitors. The pub offers both indoor seating and a popular outdoor patio that has been recognized as one of the best in Salt Lake City. The mountain setting combined with the rustic log cabin atmosphere creates a unique après-ski destination and community gathering place.

Food and Drink

The Hog Wallow offers what many consider the best bar food in town featuring an extensive menu of American grill items and regional pizzas. Specialties include house-smoked wings smoked ribs house-made chili pimento cheese spread and elevated burgers. The pub maintains an extensive list of spirits beer and wine with particular focus on bourbon whiskey and craft beers.

Awards and Recognition

Since opening in its current form Hog Wallow has received numerous accolades including City Search's Best Outdoor Bar City Weekly's Best Neighborhood Bar and Best Escape From Downtown and Salt Lake Magazine's Best Suburban Bar. The venue continues to be a favorite destination for locals and visitors seeking quality food drinks and live music in a unique mountain setting. Open Monday-Tuesday 2PM-1AM Wednesday-Sunday 12PM-1AM.
location: 3200 E Big Cottonwood Canyon Rd Salt Lake City UT 84121
